changelog: THE MENU MUSIC NOW SURVIVES BEING FOLDED TO MONO. The title theme was losing 3.4 dB when summed to mono — its two loudest voices, a contrabass drone and a tuba pedal, were in polarity opposition, so on a phone speaker, a laptop, or any store-page player over half the track cancelled itself. The boss theme had the same fault at 2.2 dB. Both are fixed at the source, and every music file is now checked for mono compatibility before it can ship.
